findings.quote: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step has no vessel and conflates the preheated external block with reaction heating. Preserve block preheating and placement as unmapped details; the following HeatChill step already represents the reaction at 80 °C for 12 h.

The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is not represented. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not include analytical monitoring.
